svg.title: billtruong003: bento profile
svg.desc: Hunter rank SS, top 0.9% of regular GitHub players, level 14, Holy Knight, title Night Owl. Role: Unity Engineer · Games, XR & Tools. Focus: Gameplay, multiplayer, VR, shaders. Base: Ho Chi Minh City · onsite Korea. Class: Holy Knight · Light. Awakened: 2022-09-26. Built Shmackle VR, a multiplayer social sandbox on Meta Quest, and an NVIDIA Omniverse digital twin shown at AI Summit Tokyo 2024. Top 6 at Vietnam GameVerse 2024. Senior Software Engineer at GEM Corporation (2026 – now); Technical Artist (from Unity XR Dev) at CurlyBlue · Shmackle VR (2025 – 2026); Unity Developer at FPT IS · NVIDIA digital twin (2024 – 2025); Game Developer at Gameloft Vietnam (2023) Six stats on a percentile web. STR SS top 2.0%, AGI B top 14%, INT B top 21%, VIT EX top 0.02%, LUK SSS top 0.4%, CHA A top 6.2%. Equipped C#, Unity, HTML. Inventory: Unity, C#, HLSL, Shader Graph, Photon, PlayFab, Meta Quest, Blender, Python, NVIDIA, C++, C, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React, Next.js, Firebase, Git, GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Figma. 2026-10-05: cleared 3 of 3 (Make one contribution 1 / 1, Keep a 3-day streak 3 / 3, Land 3 contributions 3 / 3). Weekly boss 1 of 4 days. Today: Make one contribution, Beat your daily average (2), Open an issue: a bug, an idea, a question. 126 active days in the last year rise as shadow soldiers; 15 days with 10 or more contributions become elites. “The AI writes the code, I take the blame. Basically a surrogate dad for bugs.” — Bill The Dev KeyStream-Gemini: KeyStream-Gemini is a high-performance reverse proxy designed to optimize Google Gemini API usage through intelligent key rotation and real-time monitoring. It ensures high availability and bypasses rate limits by dynamically managing a pool of API keys.. 37 stars, 15 forks, JavaScript. Bill-SSOutline: no description. 4 stars, 1 forks, ShaderLab. Thử thách biến GitHub Profile thành game RPG trong 5 phút; Thuật Thức Vô Hạn Gemini Token (Miễn là bạn còn account để tạo key); Devlog #1: Tôi làm tool free cho các bạn làm game | SPACESHIP MODULAR; Hướng Dẫn Chi Tiết Về Animator; Video sửa và bổ sung (giữa bài 7 và bài 8)
